from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=root/'task-a1e9c674.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    # A solid horizontal line separates two binary patterns. Overlay them
    # and mark cells present in both patterns with color 2.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    upper = grid[:sep]
    lower = grid[sep + 1:]
    return [[2 if upper[r][c] != 0 and lower[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(min(len(upper), len(lower)))]
'''
path.write_text(source)
